#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct QueryManifest {
    pub identity: String,
    pub producer: String,
    pub source: String,
    pub checked_ir: String,
    pub root: String,
    pub selector: String,
    pub facts: usize,
    pub root_offset: usize,
    pub root_length: usize,
    pub total_bytes: usize,
}

pub struct QueryContainerWriter<'a> {
    store: &'a mut Store,
    temporary: Directory,
    file: File,
    temporary_name: String,
    reservation_name: String,
    position: usize,
    payload_bytes: usize,
    failed: bool,
}

pub struct Store {
    io_stats: Option<IoStats>,
    directory: Directory,
    clock: Clock,
    producer: Vec<u8>,
    producer_slot: String,
    secret: Vec<u8>,
    sequence: usize,
    capacity: usize,
    index_bytes: usize,
    writer: Option<File>,
    write_state: u8,
    budget: Budget,
    dirty: bool,
    query_container: Option<QueryContainerRead>,
    pub retained_bytes: usize,
    pub evicted: usize,
    pub hits: usize,
    pub misses: usize,
    pub rejected: usize,
    pub writes: usize,
}
fn query_locator_name(identity: &str) -> String { format!("semantic-locator-v3-{identity}") }
fn query_locator_producer() -> [u8; 32] { sha256::digest(b"lkjscript-semantic-locator-3") }
fn query_latest(&mut self, selector: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> { self.read_query_latest(selector) }

pub struct QueryReader {
    directory: Directory,
    secret: Vec<u8>,
    producer: Vec<u8>,
    producer_slot: String,
    identity: String,
    selector: String,
    root: String,
    capacity: usize,
    container: Option<QueryContainerRead>,
}
fn query_root(&mut self, identity: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> { self.read_root(identity) }

struct IoCounters {
    overflow: bool,
    read_attempts: usize,
    authenticated_reads: usize,
    authenticated_payload_bytes: usize,
    authenticated_envelope_bytes: usize,
    read_ns: usize,
    pack_loads: usize,
    pack_decode_bytes: usize,
    pack_decode_ns: usize,
    pack_retain_calls: usize,
    pack_retain_ns: usize,
    put_requests: usize,
    seals: usize,
    sealed_payload_bytes: usize,
    seal_ns: usize,
    pack_reseal_calls: usize,
    pack_reseals: usize,
    pack_reseal_payload_bytes: usize,
    pack_reseal_ns: usize,
    publish_requests: usize,
    publish_attempts: usize,
    published: usize,
    published_payload_bytes: usize,
    published_envelope_bytes: usize,
    publish_ns: usize,
    prepare_ns: usize,
    metadata_ns: usize,
    budget_headers: usize,
    budget_header_bytes: usize,
    budget_manifest_bytes: usize,
    budget_container_authenticated: usize,
    budget_container_extent_checks: usize,
    stream_write_ns: usize,
    stream_completed_write_bytes: usize,
}

fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            overflow: false,
            read_attempts: 0usize,
            authenticated_reads: 0usize,
            authenticated_payload_bytes: 0usize,
            authenticated_envelope_bytes: 0usize,
            read_ns: 0usize,
            pack_loads: 0usize,
            pack_decode_bytes: 0usize,
            pack_decode_ns: 0usize,
            pack_retain_calls: 0usize,
            pack_retain_ns: 0usize,
            put_requests: 0usize,
            seals: 0usize,
            sealed_payload_bytes: 0usize,
            seal_ns: 0usize,
            pack_reseal_calls: 0usize,
            pack_reseals: 0usize,
            pack_reseal_payload_bytes: 0usize,
            pack_reseal_ns: 0usize,
            publish_requests: 0usize,
            publish_attempts: 0usize,
            published: 0usize,
            published_payload_bytes: 0usize,
            published_envelope_bytes: 0usize,
            publish_ns: 0usize,
            prepare_ns: 0usize,
            metadata_ns: 0usize,
            budget_headers: 0usize,
            budget_header_bytes: 0usize,
            budget_manifest_bytes: 0usize,
            budget_container_authenticated: 0usize,
            budget_container_extent_checks: 0usize,
            stream_write_ns: 0usize,
            stream_completed_write_bytes: 0usize,
        }
    }
